Signals a new revenue stream leveraging card data and ad spend.
Adds rewards/commerce tech to bolster platform capabilities.
Large audience scale enhances advertiser appeal.
Deep spend data can improve targeting and attribution.
Suggests potential advertiser ROI; may drive adoption.
